reads.review_status: file-read; addressed by selected host machine lowering
reads.note: Full file read. Target-dependent displacement/scaled-index bounds, tagged-base adjustment, atomic addressing restrictions and raw base+index hoisting. Ink has no source pointer/addressing-mode primitive. Selected native/Rust-Wasm code is lowered by the Rust host toolchain; JavaScript is lowered by its host engine. Such instruction legalization remains the host responsibility, subject to selected target/optimization flags; no source algebraic fact follows and debug builds promise no optimized addressing. Packed-layout codecs and bounds stay independently checked.
